request.subject: CITY:2

layers.text: Repaint the grey stone of the wall, the round tower and the keep as pale warm sandstone, a light cream-beige with slightly darker beige shading, and replace the black outline by a thin outline in a darker tone of each colour. Keep the terracotta red roofs, the cream plaster houses with dark timber framing, the gate, every shape and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the walls.
